per_leg_note: speed factors: multiply free-flow / max speed on that leg's edges while it rains. Every leg gets the corridor-wide value except legs slower on the rainy day in all 7 same-weekday pairs (only j03-j04 Gachibowli Circle -> Biodiversity jn: +20% mean, +8% median). Low confidence.

stress_test.note: upper end of the 95% confidence range; use for a 'heavy rain' what-if, not as the expected case

applies_to: hours when it is raining (>= 0.5 mm/h), 08:00-20:00, Lingampally -> Lakdikapul
basis: TomTom Traffic Stats daily 08:00-20:00 averages, 1-15 July 2026 (15 days) vs Open-Meteo ERA5-based hourly rain (mean of 3 points). Regression trip_min ~ wet_hours + Sat + Sun gives +0.26 min per wet hour (95% CI -0.58 to +1.09), i.e. +5% travel time while raining (95% CI -11% to +21%). Whole-day effect on rainy weekdays not distinguishable from day-to-day noise (61.0 vs 62.0 min). Light-to-moderate monsoon showers only (max 7 mm in a 12-hour window); heavy-rain days (17, 29, 30 July) were not covered.
confidence: low: effect not statistically distinguishable from zero with 15 days
demand_basis: no evidence either way; keep demand unchanged (assumed)
label: estimated
